scope_note: Educational summaries of traditional TCM frameworks only. These concepts are not biomedical diagnoses and should not be used to diagnose or prescribe treatment.

frameworks.description: A traditional framework for describing patterns through four paired distinctions. It is an educational model, not a stand-alone diagnostic method.

categories.description: A broad paired distinction used in traditional theory to summarize aspects of a pattern. Its interpretation depends on the full clinical context.
A traditional distinction describing whether a pattern is considered more internal or more superficial within the framework.
A traditional description of qualities attributed to a pattern; it is not the same as a measured body temperature.
A traditional distinction describing how a pattern is understood in relation to insufficiency or excess within the TCM model.

frameworks.description: The traditional categories of information gathering used by a trained practitioner. They are considered together rather than used as isolated self-diagnosis tests.

categories.description: Observing visible features as part of a broader practitioner assessment.
Attending to sounds and odors as described in traditional examination.
Asking about the person's experience and relevant history.
Touch-based examination performed by a trained practitioner, including traditional pulse assessment.
